verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
For all You've done, for all You're going to do,
We give You thanks and we lift our praise to You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We give thanks
We give praise
For we know that all things work together for our good

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
We give thanks
We give praise
For by faith we know Your grace will see us through

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
For all those things that we don't understand
We come by faith and place them in Your hands

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Even if we stumble, even if we fall
You will not forsake us
You are King and Lord of all, Lord of all
